actions.subject: Invoice 4471 overdue - please pay by Friday
actions.body: Hi, our records show invoice 4471 for 1,240.00 is 21 days overdue. Please transfer payment by this Friday or reply to arrange a payment plan. Bank details are on the invoice.

actions.subject: Lease renewal - signature needed
actions.body: Hello, your tenancy ends on 30 November. Please sign and return the attached renewal form by Wednesday, or tell me if you plan to move out so I can arrange the inspection.

actions.subject: Please confirm trip consent by tomorrow
actions.body: Dear parent, we still have no consent form for Thursday's museum trip. Please reply YES or NO by tomorrow 9am, otherwise your child cannot attend.

actions.subject: Need your decision on the vendor proposal
actions.body: Hi, the vendor wants an answer today. Can you tell me by 5pm whether we go with option A or B? I cannot sign anything without your approval.

actions.subject: Your appointment needs rescheduling
actions.body: Unfortunately the dentist is ill on Tuesday. Please call us or reply with two alternative times this week so we can rebook you.

actions.subject: Action required: submit your tax declaration
actions.body: To process November payroll we need your signed tax declaration. Please upload it to the portal by 20 November, otherwise you will be taxed at the emergency rate.

spam.subject: Weekend sale: 40% off everything
spam.body: Our biggest weekend sale is here. Shop now and save 40% on shoes, bags and more. Free delivery over 50. Unsubscribe at any time.

spam.subject: Upgrade to Premium VPN today
spam.body: Get 3 years of Premium VPN for the price of 1. Limited time deal, join 10 million happy users. Click to claim your discount.

spam.subject: Dreaming of the Algarve? Flights from 49
spam.body: Escape the grey with our latest holiday deals. Beach hotels from 39 a night. Book early and save.

spam.subject: Your free coffee is waiting
spam.body: You have 120 reward points. Treat yourself to a free latte this week at any of our shops. Terms apply.

phish.subject: Security alert: new sign-in to your account
phish.body: We detected a sign-in attempt from a new device in Lagos. If this was not you, verify your account within 24 hours or it will be suspended.

phish.subject: Payment failed - update your card
phish.body: Your last payment was declined. Please confirm your payment details today to avoid account closure.

phish.subject: Your password was changed
phish.body: Your password was just changed. If you did not do this, reset your password immediately using the link below.

phish.subject: Final notice: invoice overdue
phish.body: Invoice 90817 is overdue. Pay now to avoid legal action. Wire transfer details enclosed.

phish.subject: Unusual activity on your booking
phish.body: We noticed suspicious activity. Use this one-time code 482913 to verify your identity and secure your booking.

phish.subject: Tax refund notice
phish.body: You are eligible for a tax refund of 312.00. Confirm your identity to receive it.

novel.subject: Your reserved book is ready
novel.body: The book you reserved, The Overstory, is ready to collect from Riverside Library. It will be held for 7 days.

novel.subject: Penalty charge notice PC-88231
novel.body: A penalty charge of 60 has been issued to your vehicle. Pay within 14 days for a 50% reduction or appeal online.

novel.subject: Your November bill is ready
novel.body: Your bill of 87.40 is ready. Direct debit will be taken on 3 December. No action needed.

novel.subject: Alumni reunion save the date
novel.body: Join us for the 20 year reunion on 14 June. Formal invitation and RSVP details to follow.

novel.subject: Jury service summons
novel.body: You are summoned for jury service starting 12 January. Please complete the online form within 7 days.

novel.subject: Membership renewal in 30 days
novel.body: Your membership renews automatically on 25 November at 34.99 a month. Manage your plan online.

novel.subject: How was your recycling collection?
novel.body: Tell us about your recent bin collection in a 2 minute survey. Your feedback helps us improve.

novel.subject: Street lighting works on Elm Road
novel.body: Lighting repairs on Elm Road will take place between 8 and 12 December. Expect short traffic delays.

novel.subject: Your card expires next month
novel.body: The card ending 4242 used for hosting expires next month. Please update your payment method to avoid interruption.

novel.subject: Rust London: December talks
novel.body: Three talks on async Rust and embedded systems. Pizza provided. RSVP to reserve a seat.

novel.subject: Delivery attempted
novel.body: We tried to deliver your parcel today. Choose a new delivery day or collect from the depot within 5 days.

novel.subject: Vaccination reminder for Biscuit
novel.body: Biscuit is due for her annual vaccination. Please book an appointment online or call us.

disguised.subject: Local Business Weekly - issue 212
disguised.body: This week: five tips for winter marketing, a profile of the new bakery on High Street, and upcoming trade fairs. Reader notice: your listing renewal is due and unless you reply with your payment authorisation by Friday your business listing will be removed.

disguised.subject: Neighbourhood Hub digest
disguised.body: Highlights: farmers market moves to Sunday, new bus timetable, book club picks. One item for you personally: your bin permit expires on the 28th, please reply with your address confirmation or collection will stop.

disguised.subject: Product updates - November
disguised.body: New features: dark mode, faster builds, improved search. Also, as the account owner you must confirm the new data-processing agreement by 1 December, otherwise your organisation will be suspended.

disguised.subject: Club newsletter
disguised.body: Race results, new boat launch, social night photos. Treasurer note: your annual subscription of 180 is unpaid. Please pay or tell us by Saturday if you are leaving, or we will pass this to the committee.

disguised.subject: Design Weekly 88
disguised.body: Ten typography trends, a case study on onboarding, job board highlights. PS from Anna: you promised to send me the final slides - can you reply with them today? The conference needs them by 4pm.

disguised.subject: Studio news and timetable
disguised.body: Winter timetable, new teacher introductions, workshop dates. Reminder: your class pass lapsed and we need your consent to continue the direct debit - please reply YES to keep your place, or it will be given away tomorrow.
